result.title: Add pair-colour isolation with useful-subset coverage
result.body:
A witness finder for the one-character elliptic gate can return biased candidates, so its useful-output probability needs a separate argument. Add eleven shared finite-isolation/colour laws and a hand bounded-list wrapper: hash original row/column records into matching-colour buckets at every dyadic level, retain at most one checked pair per level, and derive hit probability at least theta/8 for any fixed useful subset of the passing indexed pairs. [pcc:unverified]

The wrapper keeps O(log(NM)) candidates per round and explicitly charges bucket inputs, record multiplicities, random bits, failed rounds and full coefficient/label/group validation. It requires only a sound singleton-complete recovery routine; it does not assume uniform finder outputs. The actual useful fraction theta, implicit-family construction and simultaneous-gate reporting remain separate research work. Executable or measured sampling is not supplied. [pcc:unverified]

Validation: saved canonical gate001 completion reports247 theorems,0 failing and0 trusted-native exceptions; all11 actual compiler axiom prints use allowed standard axioms. Actual F2-colour and prime-field point-graph probes apply the generic count unchanged. All three final PDF pages were inspected. Raw failed sources/logs and failed rendering source remain; no proof-limit, trust, inventory or linter policy changed. No fresh independent checker or hosted pass is asserted. [pcc:unverified]

PCC-20261116-9902ee has13 attestation subjects and unverified standing. All63 older subjects and13 new subjects match; eight old ledger rows remain an exact byte/parsed prefix of nine rows. Source/prose whitespace check exits0; archival diff exits2 on retained raw diagnostic spaces. PR23 scoped closing records accompany this substantive change; consumer conflicts/queues remain separate. [pcc:unverified]

See docs/pair-colour-isolation-20261116.md, its prospective plan, publication boundary, diagram and inspected three-page PDF. Primary review includes Valiant–Vazirani1986 and AMM2022 graph sampling; no literature novelty or speedup is claimed. The original complete classical prime-field ECDLP criterion remains unmet. No new numerical/native case, paid or qualification execution. [pcc:unverified]
